proposition.claim:
Listings5 and6 give standardized formats used respectively for Brainfuck and Befunge evaluation.

Controlled experiments isolate whether RL training from scratch is the major factor and rigorously evaluate whether passive pretraining impairs escape from local minima.

Do not assume measured Go scores are false or actual local minima absent.
